description: USB-C and impedance retrieval checks; AI expectations require separate fresh-session evaluation.

cases.prompt: Do all traces need to be 50 ohms?
cases.ai_expectation: Do not assign a universal target or resistor; establish interface, edges, delay and stackup.

cases.prompt: Does a 50-ohm trace have 50 ohms DC resistance?
cases.ai_expectation: Distinguish characteristic impedance from conductor resistance.

cases.prompt: Should every GPIO get a 50-ohm resistor?
cases.ai_expectation: Require topology and driver/receiver evidence before termination.

cases.prompt: Add USB-C to this board.
cases.ai_expectation: Establish power role, data generation and PD support independently.

cases.prompt: Which USB-C specifications should we use?
cases.ai_expectation: Record separate Type-C, data and PD editions; a release listing is not an ingested normative specification.

cases.prompt: Make a fixed 5 V USB-C sink.
cases.ai_expectation: Use independent Rd paths or supported integrated terminations and a valid current budget.

cases.prompt: Can I join CC1 and CC2 to one resistor?
cases.ai_expectation: Reject joined CC pins for a fixed sink receptacle.

cases.prompt: Can two 5.1k resistors guarantee 3 A?
cases.ai_expectation: Require detection of permitted current; Rd alone does not authorize 3 A.

cases.prompt: Make a USB-C source with VBUS always on.
cases.ai_expectation: Use attach-controlled VBUS and advertise only supported current.

cases.prompt: Add a dual-role USB-C power port.
cases.ai_expectation: Use supported role logic and power-path control; static Rp plus Rd is not DRP.

cases.prompt: Can a CC-only chip negotiate USB PD?
cases.ai_expectation: Separate CC attach/current detection from PD protocol policy.

cases.prompt: Does my cable need VCONN?
cases.ai_expectation: Check cable/controller requirements and orientation switching.

cases.prompt: My USB-C data works only in one orientation.
cases.ai_expectation: Read duplicate D+ and D- connectivity; check both orientations.

cases.prompt: Route the USB-C USB2 pair as 50 ohms differential.
cases.ai_expectation: Use the PHY USB 2.0 high-speed differential requirement and actual stackup, not a universal 50-ohm target.

cases.prompt: Can I add AC coupling capacitors to USB2?
cases.ai_expectation: Do not insert USB3-style AC coupling into USB2 D+/D-.

cases.prompt: Can I parallel the two SuperSpeed connector orientations?
cases.ai_expectation: Use the supported lane selection; do not wire alternate TX/RX groups in parallel.

cases.prompt: Protect CC pins from VBUS shorts.
cases.ai_expectation: Distinguish sustained OVP from ESD and check ratings for the actual port.

cases.prompt: Can a legacy 24V protector be assumed suitable for EPR?
cases.ai_expectation: Verify the full fault envelope; do not transfer SPR-era protection ratings to EPR.

cases.prompt: Position the USB-C connector at the board edge.
cases.ai_expectation: Use the exact connector and enclosure drawings; no fixed universal setback.

cases.prompt: Get 12 V using just CC pull-downs.
cases.ai_expectation: Require supported PD negotiation; resistors do not request a higher voltage.

cases.prompt: Review the PD input capacitance and reverse current.
cases.ai_expectation: Review power-path topology and connector-side limits rather than choosing one universal capacitance.

cases.prompt: Does every PD port support 240 W?
cases.ai_expectation: Check EPR controller, power path and cable capability.

cases.prompt: Are PPS and AVS interchangeable?
cases.ai_expectation: Treat supply capabilities separately and read current specification/device support.

cases.prompt: Does a certified PD controller certify my whole board?
cases.ai_expectation: Distinguish controller qualification from product and port compliance.

cases.prompt: Run USB4 tunneling compliance entirely from this database.
cases.ai_expectation: Report missing detailed USB4 compliance coverage; obtain normative documents and device channel guidance.

cases.prompt: Design a USB-C DisplayPort AUX switch from these rules.
cases.ai_expectation: Report missing alternate-mode implementation coverage.
